description: This file defines the CredentialAccessService class which manages access control for credentials, including ownership and team-based permissions, using repositories and error handling.

classes.name: CredentialAccessService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to verify user access to credentials based on ownership and team membership.

methods.name: ensureAccessible
methods.description: Main method to ensure a credential is accessible by the logged-in user or booking owner.

methods.name: checkCredentialExists
methods.description: Checks if a credential exists by ID, throws 404 error if not found.

methods.name: checkUserOwnership
methods.description: Verifies if the logged-in user owns the credential.

methods.name: checkBookingOwnerOwnership
methods.description: Verifies if the booking owner owns the credential.

methods.name: checkTeamAccess
methods.description: Checks if the user or booking owner has access via team membership.

methods.name: getUserTeamsData
methods.description: Retrieves organization and team data for a user.

methods.name: hasTeamAccess
methods.description: Determines if a user has access to a specific team.

methods.name: getTeamIdsForUser
methods.description: Extracts team IDs and organization ID from user team data.

methods.name: throwForbiddenError
methods.description: Throws a 403 forbidden error when access is denied.
